abe_solid_kappah_floor_0.rationale: Active-solid Arrhenius state set on the CI SPIDER EOS tables: s_init=2500 J/kg/K, kappah_floor=0, viscosity_solid=1e18 Pa s, yield_stress_c=1e7 Pa. Exercises Arrhenius homologous strengthening across all 100 states while F_conv < 0.5 F_tot in Pass 1 so has_lid=False and n_nodes(eta_eff != eta_diff) = 0.

abe_solid_yield_active.rationale: Yield-active lid state set on the CI SPIDER EOS tables: sub-rheological-transition interior (s_init=2150 J/kg/K, s_bot in [1950, 2150], delta_s in [1620, 1820], s_surf=330 < S_sol(0)=455.17 J/kg/K) with kappah_floor=0, viscosity_solid=3e17 Pa s, and yield_stress_c=150 Pa (yield_stress_mu=0). Pass 1 interior convection exceeds conduction (f_conv > 0.5) beneath a cold sub-solidus conductive upper boundary layer (has_lid=True in all 100 states), generating convective driving stress tau_d_lid >> tau_y_lid = 150 Pa so plastic yielding acts in 9..13 nodes across all 100/100 states.

abe_solid_default.rationale: Default state set on the CI SPIDER EOS tables: s_init=2900 J/kg/K, kappah_floor=10 m^2/s, viscosity_solid=1e21 Pa s.

flux_vs_rhs_diagnostic.explanation: Both max_rel_flux_numpy_vs_jax = 5.095372e-08 and max_rel_rhs_numpy_vs_jax = 4.584177e-10 on the CI SPIDER EOS tables occur at state index 0, basic node k = 98 (staggered cell ks = 98, P = 0.436365 GPa, S = 2057.69 J kg^-1 K^-1, phi = 0.556662). At this two-phase node (smth = 1.0, cp_blend = "latent"), rho_sol < rho_liq so the unclamped two-phase thermal expansivity a = (rho_sol - rho_liq) / (dT_phase * rho_mixed) is negative (-3.5590663210635984e-04 K^-1 in NumPy and eager JAX vs -3.5590663210635979e-04 K^-1 under jax.jit, a 1 ULP = 5.421011e-20 K^-1 division-rounding difference). The smooth positivity clamp alpha = 0.5 * (a + sqrt(a^2 + eps_a^2)) with eps_a = 1.0e-8 K^-1 (entropy_phase.py:471-473, jax/eos.py:806-808) subtracts two numbers of magnitude 3.559e-4 K^-1 that agree to 10 digits, cancelling to eps_a^2 / (4 |a|) = 7.024313e-14 K^-1 and amplifying the 1 ULP difference in a into a 2.710505e-20 K^-1 (3.858748e-07 relative) shift in alpha[98] (while eager JAX agrees with NumPy at 7.024313e-14 K^-1). Because the viscous mixing-length branch dominates at node 98 (kappa_h proportional to alpha) and two-phase latent-blend nodes use alpha_mixed exclusively (so identity_alpha / harmonised_alpha has zero effect), kappa_h[98] shifts by 2.617912e-08 m^2 s^-1, heat_flux[98] shifts by 2.082815e-04 W m^-2 (5.095372e-08 relative to peak interior flux), and rhs[98] shifts by 1.073084e-07 J kg^-1 K^-1 yr^-1 (4.584177e-10 relative to peak |dS/dt|; the 1.0e-9 harmonised-alpha smoke bound sits 2.18x above this 1-ULP shift, equivalent to 2 ULP in unclamped alpha_mixed).

six_row_call_count_table.reason: Solidus temperature T_sol(P) is cached on basic nodes during phase evaluation and reused without extra EOS table lookups.
In lid mode: 1 vector call on N_b basic nodes in phase evaluation plus 1 scalar call at (T_i, P_i) inside _compute_stagnant_lid_state_core (+2). In local mode: 1 vector call on N_b basic nodes (+1).
In lid mode: 1 vector call on N_b basic nodes in phase evaluation plus 1 scalar call at P_lid_base inside _compute_stagnant_lid_state_core (+2). In local mode: 1 vector call on N_b basic nodes (+1).
In lid mode: 1 call per RHS between Pass 1 and Pass 2 (+1). In local mode: only active when stress_closure_mode == "lid" (+0).
1 vector call on N_b basic nodes in Pass 2 (+1 in both lid and local modes).

Relative to rheology.enabled=False (0 calls), Pass 1 (theta=None) and Pass 2 (theta=lid_state["theta"] in lid mode, None in local mode) each invoke _viscous_mixing_length_factor_core once, giving +2 calls per RHS in both NumPy and JAX.
